0.original: Randall wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Leatherworkers' Guild.

1.original: You must receive Guildmaster Geva's permission if you wish to join the Leatherworkers' Guild. Seek her out in the workshop and impress upon her your desire to learn.

2.original: Though you have been accepted into the Leatherworkers' Guild, you have much to prove if you are to meet their high standard of craftsmanship. To embark upon your journey as a leatherworker, equip the knife Geva gave you and speak to her again.

48.original: Have you decided to join the Leatherworkers' Guild?

49.original: Regrettable...though I am pleased to see the gravity of the decision is not lost on you.

50.original: Few are resolute enough to work with leather, knowing full well the source.

51.original: Very well. I invite you to speak with Guildmaster Geva.

52.original: She is a brilliant artisan, personally responsible for the creation of countless Fen<hex:021F0103>Yll products. You have doubtless heard her name before.

53.original: The guildmaster's patterns are uniformly elegant, and with them even novice craftsmen can cut their materials with minimal waste.

54.original: It is for her to decide if you are fit to join us.

55.original: She can be found in the work area within. Present yourself to her and do not waver in your determination.

56.original: So you wish to become a leatherworker?

57.original: If you've spoken with Randall, then you've been told what it means to work with leather─the weight you must carry, the responsibility you must bear.

58.original: Not just to the elementals, mind you, but also to the guild. Our craftsmanship is unrivaled, and each member is expected to live up to that reputation.

59.original: Once you join, there is no turning back. If you dishonor us, I shall flay you myself and make a chocobo saddle from your hide.

60.original: Will you swear to uphold our traditions and be the best leatherworker you can be?

61.original: Swear to uphold the traditions of the Leatherworkers' Guild?

64.original: A shame. You might have made a halfway decent leatherworker─or a serviceable saddle at worst.

65.original: Very well, you may learn our craft within these walls...

66.original: ...though you seem ill equipped to do even that.

67.original: I will give you a head knife to help you on your way, but the rest is up to you.

68.original: Do not presume that your association with us means your work will bear the Fen<hex:021F0103>Yll name. Until you prove yourself worthy, you will not be permitted to so much as <hex:021A020203>touch<hex:021A020103> a Fen<hex:021F0103>Yll product, much less craft one.

69.original: Now then, if we're to continue with your initiation, you'll need to put that knife in your hand first. Talk to me when you're ready to begin.

70.original: You have unlocked a new class! You can change to this class at any time by equipping the tool received from this quest.

71.original: When changing classes, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>gear sets<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will allow you to register and save your equipment. You may then use them to switch between classes instantly without the need to manually equip weapons or equipment.

72.original: A button for the Gear Set interface is located in the upper portion of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Character<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> window.
